mechanism: Bumetanide causes electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) and orthostatic hypotension, which increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias and sudden death when combined with fluphenazine's QT-prolonging and hypotensive effects.
action: Monitor electrolytes (K+, Mg2+) frequently, maintain adequate supplementation, monitor ECG for QT prolongation, assess orthostatic vital signs regularly, and consider alternative antipsychotic if possible.
